batching_policy: sinks.csv as one batch; sources.csv grouped by repository area, chunked to <=300 rows per batch; every CSV row appears in exactly one batch record (duplicates are kept as merged records, not dropped)

rationales.sink_tp: subprocess.check_output is called with shell=True on an f-string that interpolates the parameter proccess_id_string; this is the only shell-enabled command execution in the repository and a genuine CWE-78 sink position. The in-repo caller sagemaker_setup passes the fixed literal 'dask-scheduler', so no confirmed end-to-end attacker flow exists today; retained as the pass-2 sink for Phase 2 path analysis.
rationales.sink_fp_fixed: Fixed literal argument list ['/usr/sbin/sshd', '-D'] with shell not enabled; no external input can reach the command arguments; not a CWE-78 sink.
rationales.sink_fp_test: Test file (global FP heuristic per WORKFLOW.md Step 6). Popen is called with a fixed literal argument list ['flake8', '--count', '--max-line-length', '300'] and shell not enabled; not a CWE-78 sink.
rationales.sink_fp_nvidia: Command string is the fixed literal 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.free --format=csv' split into an argument list; shell not enabled; no external input reaches the command; not a CWE-78 sink.
rationales.param_source: Parameter proccess_id_string of sync_training_processes is interpolated into the shell=True command strings at sync_remote.py:50 and :52 - the only realistic taint entry for the pass-2 sink. The sole in-repo caller passes the fixed literal 'dask-scheduler' and the module __all__ only exports sagemaker_setup, so attacker control requires an out-of-repo caller; classified candidate rather than tp for that reason.
rationales.worker_none: Parameter worker_id receives the env-derived current_host (os.environ['SM_CURRENT_HOST']) but only reaches print() output inside sync_training_processes; it never enters a command string, so it is not a pass-2 source (would be log-injection relevant at most).
rationales.cli_source: Parameter args of main() is fed by argparse.parse_args() at module level - a genuine external CLI input boundary. Reviewed the script: it drives predictor APIs and file operations only; no dataflow path to any command-execution API in this repository. Kept as a low-confidence candidate source for conservative recall.
rationales.lib_none: Internal library function parameter. No evidence of external attacker control (not an HTTP/CLI/env input boundary; AutoGluon library src has no web handlers), and no dataflow path to the repository's command execution call sites (core/src/autogluon/core/utils/sync_remote.py:16, 50, 52 and core/src/autogluon/core/utils/utils.py:890). Role none for pass 2 per the 'do not treat every parameter as attacker-controlled' rubric.
rationales.test_none: Parameter of a function defined in a test file; test files are excluded by the global FP heuristic and contain no path to command-execution APIs. Role none for pass 2.
rationales.example_none: Parameter of an example/demo or CI utility function. These scripts are not part of the library runtime; reviewed scripts show no flow into command-execution APIs (the only command-shaped value, CI submit-job.py --command, is forwarded to the boto3 batch.submit_job API, not to a local shell). Role none for pass 2.
rationales.supp_env_source: Supplementary entry (identified during source-context review of the sink file; NOT a row in sources.csv, which only extracted function parameters). os.environ read in sagemaker_setup; environment values are externally controlled by the SageMaker platform context. Feeds current_host/hosts which reach socket handling and print output, not a command sink, hence candidate rather than tp.
rationales.supp_summary: Supplementary entry (identified during source-context review; get_gpu_free_memory has no parameters so it has no sources.csv row). Project wrapper that executes subprocess.check_output (fixed command) and returns the parsed output list; summary step propagating command-output taint to callers (version_utils.py:104 and presets_configs.py:226).
